en.s: The Battle of the Holme took place in East Anglia on 13 December 902 between the Anglo-Saxon men of Kent and the East Anglian Danes. Its location is unknown but may have been Holme in Huntingdonshire (now part of Cambridgeshire). Following the death of Alfred the Great in 899, his son Edward the Elder became king, but his cousin Æthelwold, the son of Alfred's elder brother, King Æthelred, claimed the throne. His bid was unsuccessful, and he fled to the Northumbrian Danes, who, according to one version of the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, accepted him as king.

en.s: The Battle of Alton (also Storm of Alton), of the First English Civil War, took place on 13 December 1643 in the town of Alton, Hampshire, England. There, Parliamentary forces serving under Sir William Waller led a successful surprise attack on a winter garrison of Royalist infantry and cavalry serving under the Earl of Crawford. In the context of the First English Civil War, the Battle of Alton was the first decisive defeat of Sir Ralph Hopton, leader of Royalist forces in the south, and the event had a significant psychological effect on him as commander.

en.s: The Battle of Bramber Bridge was a minor skirmish that took place on 13 December 1643, during the First English Civil War. A Royalist detachment from Arundel attempted to secure the bridge over the River Adur at Bramber in West Sussex, but found a Parliamentarian force already in possession. The Royalists attempted to find another crossing point, but were ordered back to Arundel, after learning of the loss of Alton the same night.

zh.s: 1643年12月13日，第一次英国内战期间，布兰伯桥发生一场小规模冲突。阿伦德尔的王党军分队试图控制西萨塞克斯郡阿杜尔河上的布兰伯桥，却发现议会军已占据桥梁。王党军随后寻找其他渡河点，但得知同晚奥尔顿失守后，奉命撤回阿伦德尔。

en.t: Dartmouth College is founded by the Reverend Eleazar Wheelock, with a royal charter from King George III, on land donated by Royal governor John Wentworth
en.s: Dartmouth College ( DART-məth) is a private Ivy League research university in Hanover, New Hampshire, United States. Established in 1769 by Eleazar Wheelock and Samson Occom to train Native American Christian missionaries, Dartmouth is one of the nine colonial colleges chartered before the American Revolution. en.s: The Second Serbian-Ottoman War was a conflict fought between the Principality of Serbia and the Ottoman Empire. zh.s: 二战期间，美军第三集团军与德军在法国梅斯交战。战斗从1944年9月下旬持续到12月中旬，是洛林战役的一部分。德军抵抗激烈，双方都伤亡惨重。

en.t: Battle of Chosin Reservoir campaign reaches its December 13 endpoint
en.s: The Battle of Chosin Reservoir is commonly dated from November 27 to December 13, 1950. Chinese forces surrounded United Nations troops in northeastern Korea, but the UN force fought its way south in freezing conditions and reached the port of Hungnam by December 13. The subsequent evacuation from Hungnam continued beyond that date.
en.n: December 13 is the conventional endpoint of the Chosin battle, not the end of the later Hungnam evacuation.

zh.s: 长津湖战役通常记为1950年11月27日至12月13日。中国军队在朝鲜东北部包围联合国军，后者在严寒中边打边向南撤，到12月13日前抵达兴南港。此后，从兴南撤离人员和物资的行动仍在继续。
zh.n: 12月13日是长津湖战役惯用的结束日期，兴南撤离并未在当天结束。

en.t: Campaign to Suppress Bandits in Shiwandashan
en.s: The Campaign to Suppress Bandits in Shiwandashan was a counter-insurgency campaign the Chinese Communist Party fought against the Kuomintang forces that were left behind after the Nationalist regime withdrew from mainland China. The campaign was fought during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era in the region of Shiwandashan (十万大山, literally "10,000 Great Mountains") in Guangxi at the China-Vietnam border and resulted in communist victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 十万大山剿匪战役是中国共产党对国民党军队残余势力开展的一场反叛乱战役。这些部队在国民党政权撤离中国大陆后留在当地。战役发生于第二次世界大战后的中国内战期间，地点在广西中越边境的十万大山地区，最终以共产党获胜告终。

en.s: General elections were held in Barbados on 13 December 1951, the first held under universal suffrage. The result was a victory for the Barbados Labour Party, which won 15 of the 24 seats. Voter turnout was 64.6%. In this year Edna Ermyntrude Bourne, D.A., was the first woman to be elected as a member of the House of Assembly. She represented the Parish of St. Andrew until 1961. One year later Queen Elizabeth II was ascended to the Throne on the death of her father, George VI.

zh.s: 1951年12月13日，巴巴多斯举行大选，这是该国首次实行普选权的选举。巴巴多斯工党赢得24席中的15席，投票率为64.6%。埃德娜·埃尔米特鲁德·伯恩成为首位当选众议院议员的女性，代表圣安德鲁教区任职至1961年。

en.s: An earthquake struck Hamadan province, Iran on 13 December 1957 at 05:15. The moment magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck at a depth of 15 km (9.3 mi). The epicenter of the earthquake was located in the seismically active Zagros Mountains. The mountain range was also the location for several historic earthquakes. The earthquake occurred near two segments of the active strike-slip Main Recent Fault.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus for the first time on 13 December 1959. Only two candidates contested the election; Makarios III, who was backed by EOKA and John Clerides, a member of the Democratic Union, who was also supported by AKEL. The result was a victory for Makarios III, who won 66.8% of the vote, although he did not take office until 16 August 1960. Voter turnout was 91.2%. Fazıl Küçük was the only candidate for Vice-President, and was elected unopposed.

zh.s: 1959年12月13日，塞浦路斯首次举行总统选举，只有两名候选人参选：获EOKA支持的马卡里奥斯三世，以及民主联盟成员约翰·克莱里季斯，后者也获AKEL支持。马卡里奥斯以66.8%的得票率胜出，但到1960年8月16日才就任。投票率为91.2%。法齐勒·库楚克是副总统职位的唯一候选人，没有对手，自动当选。

en.t: Makarios III wins Cyprus’s first presidential election
en.s: Cyprus held its first presidential election on December 13, 1959, ahead of independence. Archbishop Makarios III defeated lawyer Ioannis Clerides and became the republic’s first president. The Cyprus government’s election archive records Makarios with 66.85% of the vote.

zh.t: 马卡里奥斯三世赢得塞浦路斯首次总统选举
zh.s: 1959年12月13日，塞浦路斯在独立前举行首次总统选举。大主教马卡里奥斯三世击败律师约安尼斯·克莱里季斯，成为共和国首任总统。塞浦路斯政府选举档案记载，他获得66.85%的选票。

en.s: The 1960 Ethiopian coup was a coup d'état staged in Ethiopia on 13 December 1960. Its goal was to overthrow Emperor Haile Selassie who was on a state visit to Brazil at the time. Four conspirators, led by Germame Neway and his older brother Brigadier General Mengistu Neway, who was commander of the Kebur Zabangna (the Imperial Bodyguard), took several ministers and other important personages hostage and gained control of most of Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia.

zh.s: 1960年12月13日，埃塞俄比亚发生政变，企图推翻当时正在巴西进行国事访问的海尔·塞拉西皇帝。4名政变者由格尔马梅·纽瓦和其兄长、帝国卫队司令梅恩吉斯图·纽瓦准将领导。他们劫持多名部长和其他重要人士，并控制了首都亚的斯亚贝巴的大部分地区。

en.s: The 1975 spring offensive (Vietnamese: chiến dịch mùa Xuân 1975), officially known as the general offensive and uprising of spring 1975 (Vietnamese: Tổng tiến công và nổi dậy mùa Xuân 1975), was the final North Vietnamese campaign of the Vietnam War that led to the capitulation of South Vietnam. In December 1974, People's Army of Vietnam's (PAVN) forces crossed from their bases in Cambodia and captured Phước Long Province by January 1975.
en.n: In the Vietnam War, the North Vietnamese forces launch their 1975 Spring Offensive (to 30 April 1975), which results in the final capitulation of South Vietnam.

zh.s: 1975年春季攻势（越南语：chiến dịch mùa Xuân 1975），正式名称为“1975年春季总进攻与起义”（越南语：Tổng tiến công và nổi dậy mùa Xuân 1975），是越南战争期间北越发动的最后一场战役，最终导致南越投降。1974年12月，越南人民军从柬埔寨境内的基地出发，于1975年1月攻占福隆省。
zh.n: 越南战争期间，北越军队发动1975年春季攻势（持续至1975年4月30日），最终导致南越彻底投降。

en.s: Malta, officially the Republic of Malta, is an island country located in the central Mediterranean Sea. It consists of two main islands, Malta and Gozo, which are 80 km (50 mi) south of Italy, 284 km (176 mi) east of Tunisia, and 333 km (207 mi) north of Libya. The two official languages are Maltese and English; Maltese is recognised as the national language.

zh.s: 马耳他正式名称为马耳他共和国，是位于地中海中部的岛国，由马耳他岛和戈佐岛两个主要岛屿组成。马耳他位于意大利以南80公里（50英里）、突尼斯以东284公里（176英里）和利比亚以北333公里（207英里）处。马耳他的两种官方语言是马耳他语和英语，其中马耳他语被认定为国语。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 13 December 1975. All 127 seats in the House of Representatives, and all 64 seats in the Senate were up for election following a double dissolution of both Houses. Malcolm Fraser had been commissioned as caretaker prime minister following the dismissal of Gough Whitlam's three-year-old Labor government by Governor-General Sir John Kerr, on 11 November 1975. The same day, Fraser advised the calling of the election, in accordance with Kerr's stipulated conditions (see 1975 Australian constitutional crisis). The Coalition of Fraser's Liberal Party of Australia and Doug Anthony's National Country Party secured government in its own right, winning the largest majority government in Australian history.

zh.s: 1975年12月13日，澳大利亚举行联邦选举。两院双重解散后，众议院127席和参议院64席全部改选。11月11日，总督约翰·克尔解散了戈夫·惠特拉姆领导的工党政府，马尔科姆·弗雷泽随后出任看守总理，并建议举行选举。弗雷泽领导的自由党与道格·安东尼领导的国家乡村党组成的联盟赢得多数并组阁，创下澳大利亚史上多数优势最大的政府纪录。

en.s: The Air Indiana Flight 216 crash occurred on December 13, 1977, at 19:22 CST, when a Douglas DC-3, registration N51071 carrying the University of Evansville basketball team, the Evansville Purple Aces, lost control and crashed shortly after takeoff at the Evansville Regional Airport in Evansville, Indiana. en.s: The 1981 Intercontinental Cup was an association football match between Liverpool of England and Flamengo of Brazil on 13 December 1981 at the National Stadium in Tokyo, Japan, the annual Intercontinental Cup contested between the winners of the European Cup and Copa Libertadores. Flamengo went on to play the Intercontinental Cup after having won the first ever Libertadores Cup they played. Liverpool were also appearing in their first Intercontinental Cup, having declined to take part in 1977 and 1978 after they won the European Cup. The teams had qualified for the competition by winning their continent's primary cup competition.

zh.s: 1981年12月13日，英格兰利物浦队与巴西弗拉门戈队在东京国立竞技场进行洲际杯决赛。该项年度赛事由欧洲冠军杯和南美解放者杯的冠军参赛。弗拉门戈首次夺得解放者杯后获得参赛资格；利物浦此前两次赢得欧洲冠军杯，但曾在1977年和1978年放弃参赛，这是他们首次参加洲际杯。

en.s: Martial law in Poland (Polish: Stan wojenny w Polsce) was in effect between 13 December 1981 and 22 July 1983. The government of the Polish People's Republic drastically restricted everyday life by introducing martial law and a military junta in an attempt to counter political opposition, in particular the Solidarity movement. Since the late 1970s, Poland had been in a deep economic recession.

en.s: The 1982 North Yemen earthquake hit near the city of Dhamar, North Yemen (now part of Yemen) on December 13. Measuring 6.2 on the moment magnitude scale, with a maximum perceived intensity of VIII (Severe) on the Mercalli intensity scale, as many as 2,800 people were killed and another 1,500 injured. The shock occurred within several hundred kilometers of a plate boundary in a geologically complex region that includes active volcanoes and seafloor spreading ridges.

en.s: On 13 December 1989 the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) attacked a British Army permanent vehicle checkpoint complex manned by the King's Own Scottish Borderers (KOSB) near the Northern Ireland–Republic of Ireland border at Derryard, near Rosslea, County Fermanagh. The IRA unit, firing from the back of an armoured dump truck, attacked the small base with heavy machine-guns, grenades, rockets and a flamethrower. A nearby British Army patrol arrived at the scene and a fierce firefight erupted. The IRA withdrew after leaving a van bomb inside the complex, but it did not fully detonate. The attack left two British soldiers dead and two wounded.

zh.t: 德里亚德检查站袭击事件
zh.s: 1989年12月13日，爱尔兰共和军临时派袭击了德里亚德一处英国陆军车辆检查站。袭击者乘坐装甲自卸卡车抵达，以重机枪、手榴弹、火箭弹和火焰喷射器攻击由苏格兰皇家边境部队驻守的检查站。附近的英军巡逻队赶到后，双方发生激烈交火。袭击者撤离前在站内留下汽车炸弹，但炸弹没有完全引爆。两名英国士兵死亡，另有两人受伤。

en.s: Flagship Airlines Flight 3379 (on behalf of American Eagle) was a regularly scheduled passenger flight from Greensboro to Raleigh, North Carolina. On December 13, 1994, the aircraft operating the flight entered a stall on approach to Raleigh-Durham International Airport and crashed 4 miles southwest of the runway threshold, killing both pilots and 13 of the 18 passengers. en.s: Banat Air Flight 166 was an Antonov An-24 (registration YR-AMR) chartered on 13 December 1995 from Romavia by Banat Air. It was due to fly from Verona, Italy, to Timișoara, Romania, when it crashed shortly after take-off, killing all eight crewmembers and 41 passengers. It later emerged that the aircraft was severely overloaded and its wings were contaminated with ice and snow.

en.s: Sin Piedad (2002) (Spanish for "No Mercy") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL), which took place on December 13, 2002 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico and replaced CMLL's regular Friday night show Super Viernes ("Super Friday"). The 2002 Sin Piedad was the third event under that name that CMLL promoted as their last major show of the year, always held in December. The main event was a traditional two-out-of-three falls Lucha de Apuestas, or bet match between Rey Bucanero and Vampiro Canadiense where both wrestlers risked their hair on the outcome of the match.

zh.s: 2002年12月13日，墨西哥职业摔角组织CMLL在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举办《Sin Piedad》（西班牙语意为“毫不留情”）摔角大赛，取代常规周五节目《Super Viernes》。这是该赛事的第三届，也是CMLL当年的最后一场大型赛事。主赛是雷伊·布卡内罗（Rey Bucanero）对阵加拿大吸血鬼（Vampiro Canadiense）的三局两胜赌发赛，败者将被剃发。

en.s: Saddam Hussein, the deposed president of Iraq, was captured by the United States military in the town of Ad-Dawr, Iraq, on 13 December 2003. The military operation to capture him was codenamed Operation Red Dawn, after the 1984 American film Red Dawn. The mission was executed by joint operations Task Force 121—an elite and covert joint special operations team, supported by the 1st Brigade Combat Team (led by Colonel James Hickey) of the 4th Infantry Division, commanded by Major General Raymond Odierno.

zh.s: 2003年12月13日，美军在伊拉克阿德道尔镇抓获已下台的伊拉克总统萨达姆·侯赛因。此次行动代号“红色黎明”，名称取自1984年的美国电影《赤色黎明》。行动由第121特遣队执行，这是一支精锐、隐秘的联合特种作战部队；第4步兵师第1旅级战斗队提供支援，由詹姆斯·希基上校率领。第4步兵师由雷蒙德·奥迪耶诺少将指挥。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Sanchez vs. Riggs
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Sanchez vs. Riggs (also known as UFC Fight Night: 7) was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on December 13, 2006 at the MCAS Miramar near San Diego, California. It was the first UFC event to take place on a military base. The audience consisted almost entirely of United States Marines stationed at Miramar; only five pairs of seats were available to the public via auction. All auction proceeds went to the Marine Corps Community Services Quality of Life Programs for the Marines and Families. The two-hour broadcast drew a 1.3 overall rating on Spike TV.

en.s: On 13 December 2018, a high-speed passenger train and a locomotive collided near Yenimahalle in Ankara Province, Turkey. Three cars of the passenger train derailed in the collision. en.s: An election for all seven members of the Federal Council, Switzerland's government, were held on 13 December 2023 for the 2024–2028 term. It followed the federal election held a month earlier and partly depended on its results. All Federal Councillors except Alain Berset were running for re-election. Per an informal agreement between the political parties known as the magic formula, incumbents are traditionally left unopposed and open seats are only contested by the incumbent's party, ensuring the partisan balance.

zh.s: 2023年12月13日，瑞士举行联邦委员会选举，选出2024至2028年任期的7名委员。此次选举在一个月前的联邦选举后举行，部分取决于该次选举结果。除阿兰·贝尔塞外，所有联邦委员都竞选连任。按各党派间非正式的“魔法公式”惯例，现任委员通常不会遇到对手；出现空缺时，通常也只有该席位所属政党的候选人参选，以维持党派间的平衡。
